items.topic: Action 2 placement — description append vs. depends_on / tag
items.context: Action 2 currently appends a paragraph to the foundation spec's description. Alternatives: (a) add a tag like `ot-p0-007` to make the inheritance searchable; (b) add a richer 'acceptance_allow'/denylist hint; (c) leave the description alone and rely solely on Action 1 (archive seeding). The tradeoff is how aggressively this research should push metadata into the foundation spec before its own workshop rounds run.

items.text: Trust/auth deep-dive confirmed: whole-tree grep across *.go for `auth|token|identity|session|tls|jwt|bcrypt|hmac|secret|bearer|x509|credential` returns zero matches outside POSTGRES_* database env handling. The four concrete artifacts of the 'trusted local' posture are now named: CLI AllowAnonymous (`cli/app.go:36`), hardcoded CORS (`api/main.go:158-171`), client-supplied paths flowing into filesystem operations (`api/main.go:222-234, 432, 449-465`), and plain HTTP transport (no TLS anywhere).

New anti-pattern surfaced in round 002: `TestCORSMiddleware` (api/main_test.go:935-998) asserts only header *presence* (`origin != ""`), never header *value*. This masks the hardcoded-origin bug from the test suite. Greenfield CORS/auth tests must assert the value a middleware emits for a specific request, not just that any value is present. Added as anti-pattern #5.

Also surfaced in the deep-dive: the CORS middleware emits headers and returns 200 for OPTIONS on ANY path, including non-existent routes, because it wraps the router before routing. This is another instance of 'no gate before the domain logic' — relevant to the greenfield design where authentication must gate routes before they're advertised to the caller.

Initiative graph check: the three downstream execute items (greenfield-vrooli-bridge-core-runtime, vrooli-emulator-remote-node-backend, macos-real-device-validation-over-bridge) already depend transitively on this research via idea/greenfield-vrooli-bridge-foundation-spec. No new items, no depends_on changes, and no moves between initiatives are warranted — reuse-before-create concluded with zero creates.

This research appears ready for conclusion. All five readiness dimensions scored at 3 after round 002: problem clearly bounded, signal catalog separates inherit/adapt/drop/avoid explicitly, 7 findings + 13 anti-patterns all backed by file:line evidence, limitations name confidence levels per finding, and Actions are concrete. Consider reviewing and processing unless d1 selects B or C.
